own: I think those numbers are a little high to start. I would like to see three amount bands per currency and five payment types per offer. We're trying to make it so they can have everything on a single offer if possible. If you can bring reasons to me why an offer cannot contain everything, then I'm open to suggestions why there can be multiple offers. But if we put dropdowns in effectively and manage the bands effectively, I'm open to suggestion. Then maybe we can make it so they can have a single offer, but if it's just not possible, then yes, tell me why and we'll have multiple offers. And then as for characters per set of instructions, are you referring to the instructions that they are putting on their offer for the payment type? Because if that is the case, I'd also want it so when they select a payment type with the dropdown, then the instructions change. So therefore there's no need to have a massive ad because the instructions just change per payment type that's selected, if that's what you're talking about for instructions. Otherwise, I need more details.
question: Are these limits right: 10 amount bands per currency, 10 payment types per offer, 1000 characters per set of instructions?
